messages:
rachel: deploy-bot triggered an autorevert for v3.9.0 during our noon change window — memory error spike on rerank-route :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT triggered for release v3.9.0 at 2025-10-25T12:07:03Z. Reason: mem_usage_rerank_usw1 > 85% for 3 consecutive windows. Rolling back to v3.8.9.
marco: odd, this PR only changed a small refactor. No memory-heavy changes.
tanya: @sre-ops can you check node oom events and recent infra activity in use1?
sre-ops: checking logs now. I see transient OOM-like evictions on worker-9 at 12:05 and a spike in retention GC at 12:06. Snippet: ```2025-10-25T12:05:22Z host=worker-9 evict pid=4212 reason=OOM_score_adj
2025-10-25T12:06:01Z runtime WARN retention_gc pause=120ms host=worker-9```
rachel: that could be caused by a telemetry sidecar mis-configured in this change. But before we let an automatic rollback proceed, can we run a quick repro on canary? If it's warmup or a single-host blip we should hold.
marco: agree. My concern is that deploy-bot is aggressive for memory thresholds during rolling deploys. We should at least pin the affected canary slice and run 3 synthetics.
sre-ops: executing: `deploybot override hold v3.9.0 --by=sre-ops --reason="investigate mem spike on worker-9"`
oncall-bot: Action recorded: deploybot override hold v3.9.0 by sre-ops at 2025-10-25T12:08:10Z
tanya: running `rerank-smoke --region=use1 --count=5` now. Initial runs: attempt1 mem=88% p95=210ms error=0.5%; attempt2 mem=62% p95=130ms error=0.1%; attempt3 mem=60% p95=120ms error=0.0%.
marco: pattern looks like a cold-start + single-host OOM during first run. I propose: 1) keep hold 2) remove telemetry sidecar from canary host pool 3) run 5 more synthetics across different hosts 4) if stable, merge hotpatch that tightens telemetry's heap cap and unhold.
rachel: assignable? Who can flip sidecar config quickly? @infra-team or @sre-ops?
sre-ops: I can cordon worker-9 and remove sidecar via `infractl`. Doing now. Also setting a 20m timer to auto-allow revert unless unheld.
oncall-bot: Action recorded: cordon worker-9 by sre-ops at 2025-10-25T12:12:03Z
tanya: reruns after cordon: run1 mem=61% p95=125ms run2 mem=60% p95=118ms run3 mem=59% p95=115ms run4 mem=62% run5 mem=63%. All green. kvcache hit unaffected.
marco: good. I'm comfortable with a hotpatch: set telemetry heap_limit=64MB and exclude sidecar from hot path. I'll open PR `hotpatch/telemetry-heapcap-2025-10-25`.
rachel: please include a short internal release-note line and a rollback communication template in the PR description in case we have to revert later. Legal doesn't need to be pinged unless customer-visible errors exceed 1%.
sre-ops: PR merged sha=9f8c7b. After merge we should run two more synthetics then unhold.
marco: merged and deployed to canary. Running final checks.
oncall-bot: Final checks: run1 mem=60% run2 mem=61% error_rate=0.0% p95=120ms
rachel: decision: unhold and rollforward. @sre-ops can you release the hold? Command: `deploybot override release v3.9.0 --action=unhold --by=sre-ops`
sre-ops: executing: `deploybot override release v3.9.0 --action=unhold --by=sre-ops`
oncall-bot: Action logged: deploybot unhold v3.9.0 by sre-ops at 2025-10-25T12:24:10Z
rachel: rollforward in progress. Monitoring for 30m. If anything crosses thresholds, we will let the rollback happen and send the prepared customer note. Thanks team.
